proposed_approved_config.activation_rule: Interim closed candidate only. Do not approve or activate until the repaired source commit and final candidate hash are bound.

superseded_submission.error: image.add_local_file requires an absolute remote_path; Windows pathlib serialized /root as \root.

remote_read_only_review.reason_hash_not_recomputed: Rehashing the remote 17.5-GB payload requires a Modal execution; the audit itself performs the bounded hash and content scan and stops on mismatch.
remote_read_only_review.free_space_precheck_deferred: The runner checks at least 1 GiB free before creating the output directory or attempt marker.

success_checks: The remote archive SHA-256 equals the frozen expected digest.
Exactly 76,347 safe image assets, 70,080 canonical page IDs, 6,267 aliases and 1,247 document IDs are reconstructed.
No same-page-ID group contains different uncompressed content hashes.
Persisted asset and canonical-page JSONL hashes and row counts reproduce on a second read-only pass.
All source snapshots, manifest fields, evidence-size limits and the success marker verify independently.
stop_conditions: Any live config, source, archive, path or count hash mismatch.
The output namespace exists before invocation.
Less than 1 GiB free Volume space is observed before attempt creation.
Any unsafe tar path, link, duplicate member path or malformed page ID.
Any same-page-ID group contains different uncompressed content hashes.
Evidence exceeds 128 MiB or persisted JSONL verification fails.
Timeout, interruption, exception or missing success marker. Stop without retry.

interpretation_limits.permits_after_verified_pass: Preparation of an OCR runtime calibration package only.
does_not_authorize: a learned or deployable QPAF improvement claim
